Class Constellation

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
application.Constellation
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
Direct Known Subclasses:
C1_Heart, C2_Capricorn, C3_Smile, C4_Lightning, C5_Dragonfly
public abstract class Constellation extends javafx.scene.layout.Pane
Abstract base class for all constellations. Each constellation has 10 stars that light up as tasks are completed.
